chunk: Shabbat/Shabbat Evening [Blessing the Children .. Zemirot for Shabbat Evening]

he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Blessing the.en: It is the custom of Israel to bless the children on Friday nights when returning from the synagogue.

parts.text: יְשִׂימְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָ: יִשָּׁא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
יְשִׂימֵךְ אֱלֹהִים כְּשָׂרָה רִבְקָה רָחֵל וְלֵאָה. יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָ: יִשָּׁא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:

he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Shalom Aleich.en: On returning home from the synagogue, say this:
he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Shalom Aleich.clean: כשבא מבית הכנסת לביתו יאמר זה:

parts.text: שָׁלוֹם עֲלֵיכֶם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:
בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:
בָּרְכוּנִי לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:
צֵאתְכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא:

he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Ribon Kol HaO.en: Say this prayer every Friday night after the Amidah, before leaving the synagogue.
he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Ribon Kol HaO.clean: תפילה זו יאמר בכל ליל שבת אחר תפלתו קודם צאתו מבית הכנסת:

parts.text: וְלַהֲגוֹת בְּאִמְרֵי שֶֽׁפֶר. בְּכָל פִּנּוֹת וּמַחֲנוֹת.
כַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּים סוּגָה. בּוֹ יָנֽוּחוּ בֵּן וּבַת.

issues.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzamah Nafshi:13
issues.detail: English covers only Hebrew lines 1-12 and 19-22; Hebrew lines 13-18 and 23-28 have no English. English lines are half-lines (two English segments per Hebrew line), and English ids skip numbers (5,10,15,20,25,30-47,52).

issues.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Kol Mekadesh:30
issues.detail: Hebrew lines 30-33 are an optional bracketed stanza ("Kadshem") printed in square brackets; no English. Tagged as ordinary prayer; whether it is sung varies by custom.
Parenthesized phrases "(כי הוא יום)" and "(כי בנו בחרת ... מכל העמים)" are variants/optional per community; left as one prayer part without condition.

Kiddush begins at he:2 "ויהי ערב ויהי בקר" (quietly) and continues in he:4 "יום הששי"; the two are one verse split across segments. Whole Kiddush is said by the head of household; Vayechulu customarily standing.

issues.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Ma Yedidut:9
issues.detail: "<small>להתענג:</small>" is a cue to repeat the bold refrain (he:5 "להתענג בתענוגים..."); tagged as instruction, not prayer text.

issues.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Yah Ribon:5
issues.detail: Refrain printed in <small> after each stanza (he:5,10,15,20,25); intentional repetition of the chorus (he:1-2), tagged as prayer.

issues.id: he:Shabbat/Shabbat Evening/Zemirot for Shabbat Evening/Tzur Mishelo:7
issues.detail: Refrain printed in <small> after each stanza (he:7,12,17,22); intentional repeat of he:1-2, tagged as prayer.
Rubric says this is said after the Amidah at the end of Friday night davening, before leaving the synagogue, yet it is placed here after Kiddush/Eshet Chayil in the home sequence.
Blessing the children and Shalom Aleichem/Eshet Chayil/Kiddush are home rituals, not part of Maariv; a reader showing this chunk inside the synagogue service would be wrong.
